promotionEvidence: CPU and memory utilization or an explicit telemetry gap

home-center-mcp.reason: Authentication, dispatch, registry, and status work must not inherit media-forge sizing.

home-center-audio-render.promotionGate: Move deterministic mixing and encoding behind a dedicated private service, preserve immutable speech stems, use native FFmpeg threads, and pass the same-stem benchmark before changing production routing.

home-center-video-render.promotionGate: Use native codec/render threads inside one artifact and scale independent shots or scenes across instances.

home-center-browser-worker.promotionGate: Prove one isolated browser session per instance and bounded session cleanup before cloud promotion.

fortress-model-foundry.reason: Direct glTF compilation owns one isolated artifact per instance and scales independent namespaced jobs across instances.

tools/deploy_dionysus_cloud.sh.reason: Dionysus is a short interactive novelty service, not a long-work worker.

tools/deploy_functions_termux.sh.reason: This deploys the MCP control plane; its guardrail is the home-center-mcp assignment.

tools/setup_google_tools_gateway.sh.reason: This is a one-time control-plane bootstrap wrapper, not a worker deployment.

tools/deploy_firebase.sh.reason: This is the legacy mixed Firebase control/data-plane deployment wrapper, not a worker deployment.
